newsitem.title: USA: Tribune gets final payout on building sale.
newsitem.headline: Tribune gets final payout on building sale.

text.p: Tribune Co said on October 1, the start of its fourth quarter, it received about $85 million as final payment on a mortgage note it held on the New York Daily News Building.
It said it used the money to pay down debt.
The mutlimedia giant said its debt level at the end of the September 30 third quarter was $926 million.
Earlier the company reported that third quarter net earnings rose to $1.00 per primary share from $0.79.
Tribune said interest expense in the third quarter increased 125 percent to $13 million from $6 million last year due to higher debt levels resulting from acquisitions and stock buybacks.

It said interest income increased 88 percent in the quarter to $8 million, due mainly to SoftKey International Inc and Qwest Broadcasting convertible deventures held by Tribune. -- Chicago newsdesk 312 408-8787
